big_case.notes: Section 11(a) strict-liability omissions standard for IPO registration statements; the SG and SEC urged review, three business/academic cert-stage amici, and the Court granted on the government's reformulated question. Consequential for securities offerings and class-action exposure nationally, and a follow-on to Omnicare and Macquarie, but technical statutory securities doctrine without constitutional or broad public-law reach.
